inlines.v: EARTH'LY, adjective Pertaining to the earth, or to this world. Our earthly house of this tabernacle. 2 Corinthians 5:1. 1. Not heavenly; vile; mean, This earthly load Of death called life. 2. Belonging to our present state; as earthly objects; earthly residence. 3. Belonging to the earth or world; carnal; vile; as opposed to spiritual or heavenly. Whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things. Philippians 3:19. 4. Corporeal; not mental.
